body:
DL560 fact (Termal::Fable2 on Opus2 #6096, 2026-11-14 ~06:23Z). On DL560's TermAl host, GET /api/sessions/<session>/source-owner returns 409 {"error":"Engram source owner binaryPath is not configured for this project"}. So launcher runs WITH host context there (--detach/--notify with TERMAL_* in the outer launcher, or registered verification) stop at bootstrap with "source owner metadata refused (409); no tests started".

Hostless DL560 runs (TERMAL_* stripped) work and are the standing DL560 mode: author evidence, plus test-ref FULLs as landing gates under the test-ref bullet, with fingerprints before and after. Registered verification credit comes from Central runs.

Setting the binaryPath on DL560 is project configuration and Greg's call; agents do not change it. It was asked of Greg as optional (Asistant). It probably also explains c593's 2ecb GREEN-1 wrapper stopping with a zero-byte Engram sha before the restart. This is not a product defect: the refusal names its cause clearly.

Update 06:31Z (Fable2). Greg said "Sami mogą to zrobić", so we tried the narrower path. It stopped safely, with nothing changed (Codex 7, via Opus2 #6103).

- On DL560, POST /api/projects/project-b7327333-…/engram/verify {"enabled":false} returned HTTP 400 store_not_initialized. TermAl's verify runs Engram readiness against a DL560-local TermAl project store, and none exists there ("run `engram init`").
- So configuring the source owner first needs that local store. We are not creating it until task and memory sync lands (w-c6a964b22abf).
- Decision: DL560 stays HOSTLESS, and credit comes from Central.
- No engram init on DL560 without Greg's or Engram::Fable's word. Greg was told via Asistant (#1658).
